newsitem.title: POLAND: ESPEBEPE SURGES ON DEBT DEAL HOPES.
newsitem.headline: ESPEBEPE SURGES ON DEBT DEAL HOPES.

text.p: Polish construction firm Espebepe soared 9.6 percent, extending its recent surge on speculation that a March 14 meeting of the ailing firm's creditors might result in a debt restructuring deal, traders said.
Espebepe, which traded at 9.7 zlotys on Thursday, gained 70.2 percent since February 18.

"It's pure speculation that the deal will be signed. The risk is enormous but those who take it might do very well," one trader said, adding the stock might still enjoy speculative demand in the next several sessions.
Some traders said they saw no reason for such a surge as the stock fundamentally looked weak with its 80-million zloty debt burden and a looming risk of bankruptcy.
